Rules: docs/DECISIONS.md D-V29. Checker: evidence-check `check_evidence.py`, unchanged. Consistent: every date, time and number the agent said after its last data-changing tool call of a reply is in the record. A: the record is that reply's data-changing calls (the rule fixed first). B: every tool call of the conversation so far (changed after seeing A). Under B, 'end time only' are flags whose only missing numbers are end times implied by a start time and a duration in the record. Confirmations without any number are counted but not rated.
